# Builds the EBCTester firmware with ESP-IDF on every push and pull request.
# Pushing a tag such as "v1.4.72" additionally creates a GitHub release with
# the firmware images attached. The tag must match PROJECT_VER in
# CMakeLists.txt, otherwise the release is not created.

name: Firmware

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build (ESP-IDF v6.0.1, esp32s3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: espressif/idf:v6.0.1
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository and submodules
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Read firmware version
        id: version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^set(PROJECT_VER "\(.*\)")/\1/p' CMakeLists.txt)
          if [ -z "$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::PROJECT_VER not found in CMakeLists.txt"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Firmware version: $version"

      - name: Build firmware
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
          . "$IDF_PATH/export.sh"
          idf.py set-target esp32s3
          idf.py build
          idf.py merge-bin -o merged.bin

      - name: Collect firmware images
        shell: bash
        run: |
          v="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          mkdir -p dist
          # OTA image: install via the device web UI (firmware update page).
          cp build/EBCTester.bin "dist/EBCTester-${v}-ota.bin"
          # Complete image: flash at offset 0x0 to a blank ESP32-S3.
          cp build/merged.bin "dist/EBCTester-${v}-full.bin"
          cp build/EBCTester.elf "dist/EBCTester-${v}.elf"
          (cd dist && sha256sum * > SHA256SUMS.txt)
          ls -l dist

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: EBCTester-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error

  release:
    name: Publish GitHub release
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check that tag matches PROJECT_VER
        run: |
          if [ "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" != "v${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} does not match PROJECT_VER ${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: EBCTester-${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}
          path: dist

      - name: Create release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          name: EBCTester ${{ github.ref_name }}
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: |
            dist/*.bin
            dist/SHA256SUMS.txt
